acceptanceCriteria: context for a source area ranks no .taskman projection paths above source; excluded/size-bound entries are counted in one summary line; tests cover both.
body: Observed in 2026-10-20 bug lanes: `corvint context` for a code area returned .taskman/tickets/*.json projections among top results and listed many excluded/size-bound entries, crowding real source evidence. Expected: Tasks-store projections are task state, not source evidence (see V1-2068), and exclusion noise is summarized.

title: corvint context ranks .taskman ticket JSON and prints noisy excluded/size-bound entries
